authenticationProfiles.writing-route: Public metadata is not identity; separate server-owned memory/control/mutation authorization.
authenticationProfiles.public-gameplay: Public validated fixed Gaming query; separate source bearer.
authenticationProfiles.public-canary: Closed deterministic protocol; no administrative authority.
authenticationProfiles.gaming-bearer: ARCANOS_GAMING_SOURCE_ACCESS_TOKEN, strict purpose-bound bearer, credential-derived actor. Other legacy secrets rejected. OAuth must separate transient/evaluation from durable storage.
authenticationProfiles.booker-bearer: ARCANOS_BACKSTAGE_BOOKER_ACCESS_TOKEN, private request marker and gptClientRegistry identity. One shared trust domain, not individual-user universe membership.
authenticationProfiles.gateway-operator: ARCANOS_GPT_ACCESS_TOKEN with ARCANOS_GPT_ACCESS_SCOPES and configured principal/workspace; never inherited by OAuth users.
authenticationProfiles.operator-or-device: Gateway operator or separately paired device; scopes, grants and operation-specific ownership. Not ChatGPT identity.
authenticationProfiles.operator-device: Trusted operator context creates native-device grant; no pilot exposure.
authenticationProfiles.pairing: Single-use native-device material plus exact origin; not OAuth.
authenticationProfiles.device: Unexpired unrevoked native credential plus origin; not accepted as ChatGPT JWT.
authenticationProfiles.bridge-secret: OPENAI_ACTION_SHARED_SECRET on supported bridge bearer/header; not accepted at new boundary.
authenticationProfiles.job-capability: Exact-job capability signed with ARCANOS_JOB_READ_CAPABILITY_SECRET, sent only as x-arcanos-job-read-token; no pilot jobs.
